findings.issue: IPv6 loopback SSRF bypass — Node.js URL.hostname returns '[::1]' with brackets but check compares against bare '::1'. All IPv6 private ranges (::ffff:127.0.0.1, fe80::, fc00::) also bypassed.
findings.recommendation: Strip bracket delimiters before comparison: const rawHost = hostname.startsWith('[') ? hostname.slice(1, -1) : hostname. Then check rawHost for ::1, ::ffff: prefix, fe80:, fc00:, fd00: prefixes.

findings.issue: Response size check runs AFTER chunk is appended to buffer. A single oversized chunk (50MB) is fully buffered in memory before req.destroy() runs.
findings.recommendation: Check data.length + chunk.length > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES BEFORE appending.

findings.issue: testFiles from ready.json passed unsanitized to execSync via string interpolation. Violates security-patterns.md §8.
findings.recommendation: Validate testFiles paths and switch to execFileSync with array args.

findings.issue: isAllowedServerUrl duplicates flow-links.js:validateUrlForSSRF but without DNS resolution — vulnerable to DNS rebinding attacks.
findings.recommendation: Import and use validateUrlForSSRF from flow-links.js, or extract shared SSRF validator to flow-utils.js.
findings.deferReason: Architectural dedup — IPv6 bypass fixed inline by sec-001. Full SSRF validator consolidation is a separate task.

findings.issue: Trailing whitespace in config override produces empty tokens from split(), failing isSafeScriptName and silently returning null.
mergeModelIntelligence inserts after marker line (nlIndex+1), not at end of section — reversed chronological order on repeated merges.
findings.recommendation: Find the end of the community section (next ## heading or EOF) and append there instead.

findings.issue: Unix path stripping misses /data/, /mnt/, /srv/, /app/, /root/ — common in Docker/CI environments.
UNSAFE_CHARS doesn't include '/' — path traversal tokens (../../../evil.js) pass isSafeScriptName validation.
safeJsonParseString comment says 'not array' but code allows arrays through (unlike safeJsonParse). Undocumented behavioral divergence.
findings.recommendation: Update JSDoc to document that arrays ARE allowed through.

findings.issue: getWogiFlowVersion catch path returns 'unknown' without setting _cachedVersion — repeats failed I/O on every subsequent call.
Dedup in mergeModelIntelligence checks entire file content instead of just the community section — can false-positive match non-community text.
Regex allows trailing hyphens (e.g., 'teams-') despite DNS-label claim in comment.
findings.recommendation: Tighten regex to disallow trailing hyphens.

findings.issue: Inline require('child_process') inside stripPII body — hides dependency from import block.
http module imported but isAllowedServerUrl enforces HTTPS-only — http transport branch is dead code.
findings.recommendation: Remove http import, use https.request() directly.

findings.issue: safeJsonParseString require'd lazily inside main() while other flow-utils functions are at module level — inconsistent.
ipMatch.map(Number) produces NaN at index 0 — works but inconsistent with parseInt pattern used elsewhere in file.
